page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server is equipped with two NVIDIA P4 GPUs, delivering a total of 16 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and dual NVIDIA P4 GPU configuration, this instance offers a cost-effective entry point for GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require the latest generation of tensor cores. It is suitable for workloads such as video transcoding, inference tasks, lightweight machine learning, and general-purpose compute tasks requiring parallel processing capabilities.
